static_traits.name: Liu Ting
static_traits.social_status: Romantic relationship with boss causing Work Increased stress; frequent client interaction; one close friend but has not yet shared specific Fears
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; have not received psychotherapy before; no similar problem history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, complete logic, highly cooperative; able to identify and describe automatic thoughts and their impact; Positive attitude, but marked Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: I keep worrying that clients will think I am lying to or deceiving them in my real estate work.
basic_info.core_demands: When these intrusive thoughts affected my Work performance and relationship with my boss, I decided to seek counseling. I want to be more confident at Work and in client interactions, reducing Anxiety.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being trusted
If I cannot perform perfectly, I will be negated and lose my Work

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a client shows doubt about any detail, it means I am not honest or not professional
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly self-reassuring and fact-checking, emphasizing information accuracy to prove myself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am lying or deceiving them.

special_situations.event: Preparing a property showing or reviewing listings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot prepare perfectly, clients will definitely not trust me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checking materials, Over-preparation to avoid any errors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If there is even a small omission, clients will think I am not trustworthy.

special_situations.event: Recalling possible client reactions at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any client was Silent or cold-faced, it means most clients do not trust me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces in-depth communication with clients, instead emphasizing procedures and facts to reduce risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: All clients will think I am not honest.

special_situations.event: Considers the impact of the relationship with the boss on work evaluation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my performance is slightly insufficient, I will be seen as unprofessional and lose my Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Being overly cautious about Work details, self-reproaching to ensure there is no point to attack
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may lose my job because of this.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be trusted, recognized and affirmed by clients and boss
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen as dishonest, being negated, and losing Work and relationships
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being questioned through perfect performance and fact-checking
Staying cautious and self-restrained to maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A practitioner easily questioned and not trusted
object_relations.object_representation: Critical clients who would doubt her motives

object_relations.self_representation: A subordinate who needs perfection to earn recognition
object_relations.object_representation: Boss / authority with coexisting pressure and judgment

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When communicating directly with clients or preparing presentations, feeling the other party may not trust me
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client interprets clients' neutral signals as judgments of dishonesty (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing facts and process in a calm, professional tone, listing evidence and details, minimizing feelings and uncertainty.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether Anxiety is shared with close friends or worries expressed in the relationship
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that expressing vulnerability may trigger negative evaluations from others or cause more trouble
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Simply acknowledging concerns without elaborating, restrained tone; if the conversation deepens, Displacing to specific Work matters.

manifestations: Despite having a close friend, not yet sharing specific Fears and worries with them
Feeling at Work that others will not trust me, producing a sense of isolation
Feeling the need to be perfect amid the romantic relationship with the boss and Work stress, experiencing Restricted choices and the constraints of external expectations
outcomes: Worrying that losing Work will lead to Restricted future choices

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept in themselves to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language expressions include: 'He is looking down on me' and 'They want to exclude me'.
manifestations: Frequently assuming clients will think she is dishonest or deceitful
Attributes inner doubt to the client's thoughts

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Persistent self-checking and fact verification to avoid errors
Worrying performance is not perfect enough and being overly cautious

exception_events.target_problem: When interacting with clients, the client usually worries about being seen as dishonest, causing Anxiety to escalate and affecting Work performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: One client was very grateful for her property search and wrote a thank-you letter; her service was positively recognized then, and Anxiety eased relatively.
exception_events.reason: Different support: the client gave positive feedback and thanks; different situation: smooth business process, transparent information; different approach: maintaining honest, open communication and professional presentation.

exception_events.target_problem: During property showings or client viewings, the client usually Anticipates negative evaluation and makes nervous mistakes.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During one house viewing, a couple praised her professionalism and performance; the interaction went smoothly, and she was better able to engage in the present.
exception_events.reason: Different support: clients' immediate praise and positive interaction; different approach: focusing on current needs, providing clear information; different situation: smooth showing process, no unexpected disruptions.

positive_force: Having received clients' thanks and praise shows professional competence and Good service
Willing to seek counseling and stay positive
Able to do fact-checking and self-monitoring, values integrity
Has reliable social resources (one close friend)
negative_force: Jumping-to-conclusions cognitive biases (Mind Reading, Fortune Telling, Overgeneralization)
Perfectionist pressure and dependence on external evaluation
Work-related Anxiety causing Sleep and diet disturbance, further weakening function
Hiding troubles from close friends, support system not yet effectively used
Worrying about losing Work, persistent negative future Anticipation

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and paranoid worries when communicating with clients or showing properties
antecedent: Preparing for or conducting property showings
Thinking that the relationship with the supervisor may affect evaluations
target_behavior.core_reason: Jump-to-conclusion cognitive biases (mind reading, predicting the future) and Perfectionism pressure, worrying about being seen as dishonest and losing Work
target_behavior.function: Escapes the risk of being questioned and negatively evaluated, seeks a sense of safety and control
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance; Relationship tension with boss; Sleep and diet disturbance
